name: Stuck In November
source:
Stuck in November is a story about TRAUMA, GUILT and RECOVERY (or lack their of), lots of not so healthy dynamics and a sprinkle of one's relationship with their life time!

[From [url=https://spesbringer.itch.io/stuckinnovember]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《困在十一月》講的是創傷、愧疚和康復（也有沒能康復的時候），裡面有一大堆不怎麼健康的人際關係，還摻了一點關於人如何看待自己這一生的思考！

［摘自[url=https://spesbringer.itch.io/stuckinnovember]Itch.io[/url]］
